source.author: verg
source.text: Postquam exempta fames epulis mensaeque remotae, amissos longo socios sermone requirunt, spemque metumque inter dubii, seu vivere credant, sive extrema pati nec iam exaudire vocatos.
source.text_original: Postquam exempta fames epulis mensaeque remotae, / amissos longo socios sermone requirunt, / spemque metumque inter dubii, seu vivere credant, / sive extrema pati nec iam exaudire vocatos.
source.text_english: After hunger was banished by the meal and the tables removed, they inquire after their lost companions in lengthy conversation, and, uncertain between hope and fear, whether they should believe them alive or that they suffer their last fate and now can no longer hear those who call to them.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: pateant montes silvaeque lacusque cunctaque claustra maris; spes et metus omnibus esto.
reuse.text_original: pateant montes silvaeque lacusque / cunctaque claustra maris; spes et metus omnibus esto.
reuse.text_english: Let the mountains and forests and lakes and all the barriers of the sea be laid open; let hope and fear be for all.
